title: Avian mortality at solar energy facilities in Southern California: A preliminary analysis
abstract: This report sumarizes data on bird mortality at three solar energy facilities in sourhtern California: Sesert Sunlight, Genesis, and Ivanpah. These facilities use different solar technologies, but avian mortaility was documented at each site. Desert Sunlight is a photovoltain facility, Genesis employs a trough system with parabolic mirrors, and Ivanpah uses a power tower as a focal point for solar flux.
